kept.spine: Soldiers here are paid to be soldiers, and no part of the town's safety falls to the townsfolk.
People here can afford to quarrel about something other than money.
The town is run on the expectation that it goes on being the town.
The walls and the citadel are sound work, and neither of them is for show.
The furrier's district and the warehouse district are both inside these walls, and a man may live in one and not know the other.
